```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS clientes
FROM (
    SELECT cliente_id
    FROM pedidos
    WHERE estado = 'entregado'
    GROUP BY cliente_id
    HAVING 
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN fecha BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' 
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 
            END) > 0
        AND 
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN fecha BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' 
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 
            END) = 0
) AS sub;
```
